$description: What is enforced vs convention for token use in generated output.

rules.text: Reference semantic/component tokens (color.text.primary) rather than raw values (#f0ede6 / oklch).
Never introduce a colour, radius, shadow, easing or size that is not in tokens/00-foundation (which mirrors src/index.css :root + the real CSS literal histogram; verify_all checks each cited value).
PageSpec.theme enum is ['dark'] (schema). There is no light theme; the red hero is a brand surface.
PageSpecs carry content, variants, motion and asset roles only; no style overrides exist in the schema (additionalProperties false).
Chalet ships weight 400 only; headings use font-weight 700 (browser faux-bold) exactly as the source does (spec §0.2). Do not substitute a real bold cut.
Buttons/cards use the 14px chamfer clip-path (radius.chamfer), not rounded corners. The clipped hover shadow is a faithful quirk.
font.family.display (Chalet) is commercially licensed; production builds must license or substitute it.
